title: UNIQUE INDEX at DB layer enforces idempotency even if app logic regresses
description: KITH-orvy.3 fix adds UNIQUE INDEX on (chat_id, sender_msg_id) at the SQLite layer, not just application-level dedup. This is correct defense-in-depth: a future application bug that skips the idempotency check cannot produce duplicate message rows. A contributor might suggest removing the DB constraint as 'redundant' since the app already checks. It is not redundant — the DB constraint is the last line of defense and should stay.
